question: Which observed quality changes survive paired controls for annealing, penalty and schedule horizon?
conclusion: CRA has positive paired mean changes on six of eight cases under both fixed updates and timed controls, with a negative PrimaryW effect and a zero PrimaryS effect retained; penalty and matched-horizon changes are case-dependent rather than uniformly favorable.

panels.a: Eight cases: CRA minus no annealing after the same 1600 updates, baseline penalty 2.
panels.b: The same eight cases: CRA minus no annealing at the strict 30-second cutoff.
panels.c: Five weak-MIS cases: penalties 1.1, 2, 4 and 8 relative to penalty 2 after 1600 updates, CRA held fixed.
panels.d: Five weak-MIS cases: original matched compressed5 minus fixed30 at cutoff5; sampling-corrected child targets[5,15] minus fixed30 at cutoff15. The original unmatched targets[15] comparison is retained only as a diagnostic.

pairing: Pair model seeds 0,1,2 within the same instance and definition only after checking matching initial_state_sha256 and feature_sha256. Report 100*(treatment_size-reference_size)/n in percentage points.
statistics: Point is the mean of the three paired differences; error bar is their observed minimum-to-maximum range, not a confidence interval. No hypothesis tests. Repeated model seeds are technical repeats of one case.
data_policy: All relevant cases and all three seeds retained, including zero and unfavorable results; fixed-step and timed controls are separate panels and are never pooled. Save the complete audited summary rows in source data.
sampling_correction: The original compressed15 targets[15] omitted the 4.9s candidate request and 5s snapshot. A separately bound child with targets[5,15] corrects that protocol mismatch; its requested sampling and snapshot calendar before 15s matches fixed30. This is a sampling-protocol correction, not selection by observed outcome. Both original unmatched rows and the child's extra 5s rows remain in source data.
qa: Final rendered alignment, glyph-size, source and collision checks; inspect each panel and whole figure.
limits: Fixed 1600 updates are not equal wall time.
Timed variants are independent executions with matched initial hashes; different schedules may complete different numbers of updates.
All ablation cases were previously examined and do not select a new configuration.
